thesisCurrent.label: buildable civic workflow, unvalidated business

registryContext.note: Personal/research asset, not near-term investible BOS unless operator confirms business intent.

customerDefinition.primary: United States resident with a concrete civic issue who wants researched, properly routed constituent communications.

revenueModel.implementationGap: Payment route hardcodes tiers and does not dynamically enforce margin before checkout.

marketSizing.method: Bottom-up scenario ladder because no network research was available.

scenarios.name: niche utility
scenarios.paidSubmissionsPerMonth: 1,000 [assumption: local SEO and repeat metro wedge]

marketSizing.residualGap: External market data must be sourced in a network-enabled pass.

financials.model: Revenue equals monthly paid submissions x average realized package price x 12 months [assumption: annual model form].

launchYear.revenue: USD 34,560 [assumption: 180 paid submissions/month x USD 16 x 12]
launchYear.fixedPlatform: USD 5,400 [assumption: USD 200/month platform plus USD 250/month data provider]

scaleYear.revenue: USD 194,400 [assumption: 900 paid submissions/month x USD 18 x 12]

expansionYear.revenue: USD 600,000 [assumption: 2,500 paid submissions/month x USD 20 x 12]

sensitivityTests: 1 percent conversion instead of 3 percent reduces revenue by about 67 percent [assumption: arithmetic comparison].
25 percent COGS plus payment fees instead of 12 percent lowers launch-year EBITDA by USD 4,493 [assumption: 13 percent x USD 34,560].
USD 500/month local data provider instead of USD 250/month adds USD 3,000/year fixed cost [assumption: USD 250 x 12].

competition: Resistbot [assumption: named category, no network verification]
Change.org [assumption: named in MASTER_PLAN.md, no network verification]
Quorum [assumption: named in .planning/PROJECT.md, no network verification]
VoterVoice [assumption: named in .planning/PROJECT.md, no network verification]
Manual official contact [assumption: inherent free substitute]
LegalZoom / attorneys [assumption: category substitute, no network verification]

nearTerm: Private beta in manually verified metros [assumption: operator-led launch plan].
First 100 prospective users from operator channels and local civic threads [assumption: channel hypothesis].
No paid acquisition before conversion and deliverability proof [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md].
validationGates: 95 percent federal/state coverage and 60 percent local coverage [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md]

holes: Users may not pay despite liking the concept.
Government deliverability may fail and invalidate the paid promise.
Citation errors may damage trust or create legal-adjacent exposure.
Moderation and abuse may overwhelm one operator.
Consumer-only market may be too small for a venture outcome.
Registry says this may be a personal/research asset rather than a near-term business.
mitigations: Require paid beta conversion before SEO scaling.
Measure delivery acceptance and enforce bounce thresholds.
Keep citation verification mandatory and strip unverified citations.
Track review queue age and operator time.
Treat organization/API wedge as a separate validation gate.
Require operator ruling before wrk.vc promotion.
residualRisks: Willingness to pay remains unknown until real checkout events.
Legal/political-speech sensitivity remains even with moderation.
The moat is weak until real delivery volume accumulates.
